highlights: Added Pro Drinks with saved recipes, traditional preparation methods, ingredient stock links, and guest-menu publishing.
Added 33 editable bar classics and an Add Classics action that preserves existing recipes.
Added a Pro Shopping List organized by drink, with each missing or out-of-stock ingredient listed once.
Added pre-filled Add to Bar Stock actions with automatic recipe links and duplicate-free restocking.
Added App-Only Stock Categories in Settings > General to hide garnishes and extras from public displays and menus.
Removed the dashboard Bar Stock card; full inventory remains available from the Bar Stock navigation link.
Added Pro profiles with higher tap and keg capacity.
Added multiple display boards with per-display tap assignments for Pro profiles.
Added POS pour mode and POS Sync provider configuration for Pro profiles.
Added owner-managed 30-day Pro trials and signed license activation.
Added downloadable offline activation requests for the Keystone license portal.
Bound signed licenses to the requesting BarTender instance.
Added an optional owner-only link to the configured license portal.
Restricted licensing controls to the owner and management UI.
Added read-only active CORS origin status in Settings > About.
Updated the cryptography dependency to address current security advisories.
